property_summary: For any non-blacklisted actor, calling getTokens (distributions via distr) must credit the actor's balance with a strictly positive token amount (balanceOf(actor) > 0 afterwards); the mutant drops the balance credit in distr, so balanceOf(actor) stays 0 for any freshly deployed actor.
change_summary: Delete the line crediting _amount to the recipient's balance in distr, so distributions no longer increase balances.
